initial_prompt: Explain the difference between RAM and an SSD in exactly 3 short sentences. No bullet points.

messages.content: Explain the difference between RAM and an SSD in exactly 3 short sentences. No bullet points.

RAM (Random Access Memory) is a very fast, temporary memory that your computer uses to store data it’s actively working on. An SSD (Solid State Drive) is a slower, permanent storage device that holds your files and programs even when the power is off. In simple terms, RAM is like your desk space for current tasks, while an SSD is like a filing cabinet for long-term storage.
